items.q: Do I need any special hardware for QR Zaman?
items.a: No. Just print the QR code you generate in the panel and put it on the wall. Employees scan it with the QR Zaman app on their own phones.

items.q: Can an employee clock in for someone else?
items.a: No. Each account is bound to a single device, the phone's location is captured at the moment of scanning, and fake location apps are detected.

items.q: Is payroll calculated according to current regulations?
items.a: Tax brackets, social security rates, minimum wage exemptions, severance and notice rules and public holidays are kept per year and copied to the new year in one click.

items.q: Can I manage more than one company and branch?
items.a: Yes. QR Zaman works with a group, company, branch and department hierarchy, and every user gets their own access scope.

items.q: How do I import my existing employee list?
items.a: Download the ready Excel template, fill it in and import it in one go; you get a result report for every row.

qrPdks.intro: With QR code attendance, employees clock in and out by scanning the QR code at their workplace with their own phone. Their location is captured at the moment of the scan, fake GPS is detected and each account is paired to a single device. Records reach the panel instantly and move to the timesheet daily or monthly.

benefits.title: Start without card readers
benefits.text: A printable A4 QR poster and your employees' own phones are all you need. No fingerprint scanners, badges or installation crew.

benefits.title: Location and device checks
benefits.text: The scan location is stored with each record, clock-ins from fake GPS are blocked and an account cannot be used from another phone.

benefits.title: From clock-in to timesheet
benefits.text: Transfer attendance records to the timesheet daily or monthly, so nobody adds up hours by hand at month end.

showcase.title:
Every punch,

on the record.
showcase.text: Clock-in and clock-out times, regular hours, overtime and leave appear on one screen. Open any record to see which location it was scanned at, down to the latitude and longitude. Filter by department and date range, correct a wrong time or clear a record, and employees get a warning on duplicate entries such as a second clock-in on the same day.

steps.title:
Set up in

three steps.
items: Define a location for each department with latitude and longitude in the panel, or save your current spot in one tap from the mobile app on site.
Download the location's QR code as a PNG or as a print-ready A4 PDF poster and put it up at the entrance.
Employees choose Clock in or Clock out in the app and scan the code; the location is verified and the record lands in the panel.

qrPdks.capabilitiesText: QR code attendance shares its data with shift definitions and timesheets. When allowed, employees view their own attendance records on mobile, while managers follow late arrivals, absences and overtime in the reports. Because every record keeps its clock-in, clock-out, regular hours and overtime, month end brings a ready timesheet instead of a debate.

shiftManagement.intro: Shift management software lets you set up shift definitions for each branch and department. Once night shifts, break times and weekly rest days are defined, total working, break and overtime hours are calculated automatically, and QR code attendance records flow into the timesheet according to those rules.

benefits.title: Shifts per branch and department
benefits.text: If your store, production line and office work different hours, give each its own shift; shift work and the weekly rest day are set on the employee profile.

benefits.title: Hours past midnight
benefits.text: The night shift option covers work that runs past midnight, and working and break times are calculated against the shift.

benefits.title: Breaks and overtime handled
benefits.text: Total working, break and overtime hours come straight from the shift definition, with daily and monthly totals on the overtime sheet.

showcase.title:
Overtime,

accounted for.
showcase.text: The overtime sheet shows every employee's daily overtime and monthly totals in one table. Filter by branch, department and month to focus on a team; overtime calculated from the shift rules moves into the timesheet and from there into payroll. The attendance report also lists late arrivals, late departures, absences and who worked overtime.

steps.title:
Shifts ready in

three steps.
items: Pick a branch and department, then enter the shift's working hours, break time and, if needed, the night shift option.
Mark shift work and the weekly rest day on each employee profile.
As employees scan in, working, break and overtime hours are calculated against the shift and moved to the timesheet.

shiftManagement.capabilitiesText: Shift definitions are the foundation of attendance and timesheets. Since everyone's shift, break time and weekly rest day are known up front, overtime is calculated the same way for every employee. Create separate rules for production lines, stores or night teams and compare the results on the overtime sheet and in the attendance report. Every output exports to Excel, PDF or Word.

timesheet.intro: With QR Zaman's timesheet software you no longer wait for month end. QR code attendance records move into the monthly timesheet daily or monthly, and working days, weekly rest days, public holidays and leave show up in a single table. Mark missing days from the toolbar and fill in timesheets for many employees at once.

benefits.title: From attendance to timesheet
benefits.text: No copying clock-ins by hand: a daily or monthly transfer fills in the timesheet on its own.

benefits.title: Bulk timesheet entry
benefits.text: Pick a day type in the toolbar and click; select several employees or the whole calendar to finish a month in minutes.

benefits.title: My Timesheet calendar
benefits.text: When you allow it, employees see their own timesheet as a monthly calendar in the mobile app, with a summary of the month.

showcase.title:
The whole month

on one sheet.
showcase.text: The monthly timesheet lines up every employee against every day of the month. Day types such as annual leave, excused absence, maternity, marriage and bereavement leave each have their own code. Open an employee to see their daily timesheet, monthly summary and other totals, while the overtime sheet lists daily overtime and totals by branch, department and month.

steps.title:
Timesheets in

three steps.
items: Transfer attendance records to the timesheet for the day or month you choose in one click.
Mark public holidays, leave or excused absences from the toolbar, or use bulk entry when needed.
Check the monthly summary on the employee detail page and use the finished timesheet as the basis for payroll.

timesheet.capabilitiesText: The timesheet is the bridge between attendance and payroll. Clock-ins flow into the timesheet and the timesheet flows into payroll, so you never keep the same data in three different spreadsheets. Day types separate public holidays, annual leave and excused absences, and employees with access check their own days worked, hours and overtime on the My Timesheet screen.

In the QR Zaman CRM, team tasks and reminders are kept in the same module as customer cards, sales opportunities and quotes, so whoever opens a task never has to look elsewhere for the customer or the deal. Managers follow the team's workload with the CRM dashboard and sales and performance reports. Role-based access means dealers see only the menus they are allowed to, and every list supports search, filters and bulk actions and exports to Excel, PDF or Word.

mobileApp.intro: With the QR Zaman attendance mobile app, employees clock in and out by scanning the QR code at work, send leave and salary advance requests from their phone, and check their payslips, timesheets and attendance records. Managers approve requests on mobile, open their team lists and save new QR points on site.

benefits.title: Location and device checks
benefits.text: Location is captured at the moment of the scan, fake GPS is detected and each account pairs to one device; camera images are never stored.

benefits.title: Requests in your pocket
benefits.text: Leave and advance requests, remaining leave, the latest payslip and earnings and deductions summaries are on the employee's home screen.

benefits.title: Approvals and field setup
benefits.text: Managers approve or reject requests, view employee lists and save their current spot as a QR point in one tap.

showcase.title:
Scanned on the phone,

live in the panel.
showcase.text: When an employee clocks in or out in the app, the record reaches the admin panel together with the latitude and longitude of the scan. Duplicate entries are checked, and employees are warned when they try to clock in twice on the same day. If location services are off, the app sends the user to settings. Sessions are protected with encrypted device storage, and users sign in with a username or phone number.

steps.title:
Get started in

three steps.
items: Download the app from the App Store or Google Play and sign in with your username or phone number.
Your phone pairs to your account at first sign-in, so the account cannot be used from another device.
Choose Clock in or Clock out, scan the QR code and see the confirmation on screen.

mobileApp.capabilitiesText: The mobile app brings the daily work of employees and managers into one place. On their home screen, employees see today's clock-in and clock-out, live working time, remaining leave and their latest payslip, and can hide or show their salary. The manager home screen shows active employees, today's arrivals, people on leave, pending requests and upcoming birthdays. What employees see depends on the company's permission settings.

multiCompany.intro: Multi-company management brings your groups, companies, branches and departments together in one hierarchy. You work by picking the group, company, branch and period (year/month) from the top bar, and each user gets a permission scope by group, company or branch. Groups with several companies and multi-branch businesses no longer need separate systems.

benefits.title: Group → Company → Branch → Department
benefits.text: Set up your organization on four levels and switch each level active or inactive on its own.

benefits.title: Pick from the top bar
benefits.text: Group, company, branch and period selection is in the top bar on every screen, so you never sign out to switch branches.

benefits.title: Registration details on file
benefits.text: Tax office and number, MERSIS, trade registry, İŞKUR and workplace social security numbers are kept on company and branch cards.

showcase.title:
From company to department

in one tree.
showcase.text: The corporate management screen lists groups, companies, branches and departments nested inside each other. Company and branch cards hold the activity code, opening and closing dates, ownership type and province and district. Department cards store the location, the person in charge and working hours, and QR points and shifts are defined by branch and department as well.

steps.title:
Set up your structure

in three steps.
items: Define the group and its companies with their official details.
Add the branches and departments under each company and assign a location and person in charge to each department.
Give users a permission scope by group, company or branch.

multiCompany.capabilitiesText: A multi-company structure matters for daily work, not just for corporate records. Shift definitions, QR points and reports work per branch and department, so head office sees every company while a regional lead sees only their own branches. With the period picker, you never hunt for an archive screen to go back to an earlier month's timesheet or payroll.

rolesPermissions.intro: With roles and permissions in QR Zaman, admin, manager, employee, dealer and support users see only the menus they are allowed to. Add users, track their last sign-in and give each one a permission scope by group, company or branch. You also decide whether employees can see their own attendance, timesheet and payslip.

benefits.title: No unnecessary screens
benefits.text: Each role sees only the menus it is allowed to, so people stay focused on their work and your data is not exposed without reason.

benefits.title: Group, company, branch
benefits.text: Open only their own branches to a regional lead and every company to head office, with the scope set per user.

benefits.title: You decide what they see
benefits.text: Turn on or off whether employees see their own attendance, timesheet and payslip, and whether they can clock in at any location.

showcase.title:
A dashboard

for every role.
showcase.text: Managers see active employees, today's arrivals, people on leave, pending requests and a payroll summary. Employees see their own clock-ins, latest payslip, remaining leave and advance and deduction totals. The same panel opens a different home screen depending on the signed-in user's role, and last sign-in tracking in user management shows who logged in and when.

steps.title:
Grant access in

three steps.
items: Add a new user in user management and choose their role.
Define the groups, companies or branches the user works with as their permission scope.
Set in company settings what employees may see of their own records.

rolesPermissions.capabilitiesText: Permission management lets different teams use QR Zaman at the same time, safely. HR and payroll work with all employee data, branch managers see only their team, employees see only their own records and dealers see only the menus they are allowed to. In the mobile app, sessions are protected with encrypted device storage, and each account pairs to one device, so it cannot be used from another phone.

dashboard.intro: The QR Zaman HR dashboard shows active employees, today's arrivals, people on leave today and pending requests on the very first screen of the panel. A payroll summary, upcoming birthdays and gender and employee group charts sit on the same page. The calendar shows public holidays and eves so you can plan around them.

benefits.title: Who is in, who is off
benefits.text: First thing in the morning, see who has arrived and who is on leave at a glance, without calling anyone.

benefits.title: No missed approvals
benefits.text: Pending requests show on the dashboard with their counts, and the same summary appears on the manager's mobile home screen.

benefits.title: For employees too
benefits.text: Employees see today's clock-in, their latest payslip, remaining leave and length of service on their own dashboard.

showcase.title:
A calendar with

holidays built in.
showcase.text: Switch between year, month and week views in the calendar. Public holidays, half-day eves and special days are marked for you, with estimated dates shown for religious holidays. The header calendar lets you check holidays from any screen, so you can plan shifts and leave ahead of time.

steps.title:
Start your day in

three steps.
items: Sign in to the panel and your role's dashboard opens.
Check today's arrivals, people on leave and pending requests.
On the move? See the same summary on the manager home screen of the mobile app.

dashboard.capabilitiesText: The dashboard is the first screen everyone sees in QR Zaman, and it changes with the user's role. The manager dashboard puts active employees, today's arrivals, people on leave today and pending requests at the top, with a payroll summary, upcoming birthdays and gender and employee group charts below. The employee dashboard shows today's clock-in, the latest payslip, remaining annual leave, next leave, this year's advance, earnings and deduction totals and length of service. The header calendar shows public holidays and eves from any screen in one click.
